analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]

· Significant drop relative to SMA100/200 ($392.77/$414.09) — Mid/long-term trend weakening.

· RSI trajectory (39.2 → 27.3) — Entered oversold territory, downward momentum continues.
· MACD histogram trajectory (histo -2.8186 → -9.4434) — Weakness persists and worsens, accelerating decline after dead cross.

· Swing Support ($300.41) — Area near the 52-week low and Pivot S1 ($264.71).

[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.81) — Subdued compared to the 5-day average, reducing the reliability of the move.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) — RSI oversold, MACD weak convergence continues, lack of volume indicates no directional bias. Maintain 'watchful waiting' and monitor support at $300.41.
